named_timing_parameters.tCK: Quarter-speed master clock period (e.g. 1.25 ns at CK=800 MHz for 6400 Mbps; 0.9375 ns at CK=1066 MHz for 8533 Mbps).
named_timing_parameters.tWCK: Full-speed Write Clock period = tCK/4 (e.g. 0.3125 ns at WCK=3200 MHz for 6400 Mbps).
named_timing_parameters.tWCK2CK: WCK-to-CK synchronization window required before a high-speed transfer (WS_FS/WS_RD/WS_WR).
named_timing_parameters.tRC: ACTIVATE-to-ACTIVATE delay (same bank); tRC = tRAS + tRP.
named_timing_parameters.tFAW: Four-Activate-Window: at most four ACTIVATEs within this window.
named_timing_parameters.tRRD_L: ACTIVATE-to-ACTIVATE delay, same bank group (bank-group mode).
named_timing_parameters.tWR: Write recovery time (last write data to PRECHARGE).
named_timing_parameters.tREFI: Average refresh interval (temperature-dependent: normal / extended / low-temperature ranges).
named_timing_parameters.tMRD: Mode Register Set delay before a subsequent command.
named_timing_parameters.tZQCAL: ZQ calibration time (start / latch via MPC).
named_timing_parameters.RL: Read Latency (programmed per frequency set point).
named_timing_parameters.WL: Write Latency (programmed per frequency set point; Set A / Set B selectable).

voltage_levels.Vref_ca: Internally generated reference for CA / CS inputs (per frequency set point).
voltage_levels.Vref_dq: Internally generated reference for DQ / DMI inputs (per frequency set point / DVFSQ).
voltage_levels.signaling: Low-power low-voltage-swing single-ended (CA/CS/DQ/DMI) + differential CK/WCK/RDQS; receiver DFE / tx-rx equalization.

clock_constants.data_rate_per_pin_relative_to_WCK: 2x (double data rate at the WCK rate)
clock_constants.command_rate_per_pin_relative_to_CK: 2x (CA bus is double data rate at the quarter-speed CK)

key_constants_for_RTL_authoring.data_format: binary; byte-group organized; DBI on DMI

default_signal_values_when_idle.CK: Differential, quarter-speed, toggling in active states.
default_signal_values_when_idle.WCK: NOT toggling when idle; enabled only after WCK2CK synchronization before a transfer.
default_signal_values_when_idle.CS: Drives command framing; bounds low-power-mode duration.
default_signal_values_when_idle.CA[6:0]: Encodes NOP when no command is being issued.
default_signal_values_when_idle.DQ: High-impedance when neither side is driving.
default_signal_values_when_idle.DMI: Don't-care between bursts; carries DBI / mask during transfers.
